title: D2P Capabilities
description: Capability negotiation document of an implementation (documentType 'd2p:capabilities'). It states the standard version, the capability, feature-type and evaluator-profile versions and the conformance levels an implementation supports. Initial capability versions of release 1.0: 'd2p:core', 'd2p:pattern', 'd2p:measurement', 'd2p:eval', 'd2p:validation', 'd2p:command', 'd2p:event', 'd2p:error', 'd2p:print', 'd2p:benchmark', 'd2p:feature-set', 'd2p:expression' and 'd2p:digest' (= digest profile d2p-digest-v1), all at 1.0.0. An implementation MUST answer requests needing an unknown feature with error code 'unsupported_capability' and a snapshot fallback, never with a silent change of a construction.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

implementation.description: Name and version of the implementation.

standardVersion.description: Highest standard release the implementation implements.

capabilities.description: Supported capability versions (for example 'd2p:pattern' 1.0.0). Written as [] when there are none.

featureTypes.description: Supported feature types with their versions, including extension feature types the implementation can evaluate. Written as [] when there are none.

evaluatorProfiles.description: Evaluator profiles the implementation offers. Written as [] when there are none.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-c14n-v1 over the whole document, excluding 'contentDigest' itself).

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

conformanceClaim.title: Conformance claim
conformanceClaim.description: Claimed conformance levels of the standard and, optionally, of the print conformance profile.

levels.description: Claimed conformance levels (each separately runnable). Written as [] when none is claimed.

printProfile.description: Claimed levels of the print conformance profile. Absent when no print conformance is claimed.

printConformanceClaim.title: Print conformance claim
printConformanceClaim.description: Claimed levels of the print conformance profile 'd2p:print-v1'.

profileId.description: Print conformance profile; always 'd2p:print-v1' in release 1.0.

levels.description: Claimed print conformance levels. Written as [] when none is claimed.
